notes.title: Major HVOR Update
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37044918/d38eea75d99768406488ce4057497d5696149827.jpg"]
Hello survivors!
We’re excited to present a major update we’ve been working on over the past few months.
[hr][/hr]New Technology
Migration from UE4 to Unreal Engine 5

Support for dynamic lighting and ray tracing

Reworked networking, stable online and cross-platform play

Added support for Linux and macOS

We know the game is now more demanding on graphics cards, but it’s been almost 5 years since the last update — most players now have much more powerful hardware, so this shouldn’t be an issue.
[hr][/hr]Interface
The UI has been refreshed and modernized.
Gameplay itself hasn’t changed yet — this step was all about building a foundation for the future. The main goal was to move away from outdated technologies so we can continue to grow and update faster.
[hr][/hr]Language Support
HVOR is now available in multiple languages:

Deutsch (German)

Italiano (Italian)

Türkçe (Turkish)

中文 (Chinese)

日本語 (Japanese)

한국어 (Korean)

Español (Spanish)
[hr][/hr]What This Means
Now that the game is fully running on a new architecture, we can release updates more frequently, add new modes and maps, and deliver improvements based on your feedback.
[hr][/hr]One More Thing
HVOR remains a free game, supported with enthusiasm and in the developers’ spare time.
Thank you for staying with us — the best is yet to come!

notes.title: 2 new maps and 2 new game modes
notes.content:
Hi, we want to present a big update that we have been working on for the last 4 months.

New maps

Metro
Metro, there are rumors that the disease was brought by a rat biting a passenger in the subway. The ghouls that are here are especially evil.

Shelter
Shelter, many took shelter here when the street became dangerous. But the disease has also penetrated here, engulfing those who have taken refuge in it. They say there are a lot of weapons left in the bunker. But who will go to meet death ?

New game modes

Rat
Rats are able to adapt to any conditions, to any environment. But HVOR decided to adapt them by herself, making from these creatures creepy little zombies. The new role of rats in the food chain has not changed so much, but now we need to clearly understand what threat the new form of these rodents. In the rat mode, you have to collect a certain amount of biomaterial for research - dead rats. A flashlight will help to navigate in the dark.

Generator
"The world has changed, but the infrastructure continues to work for unknown reasons.
Electricity is supplied, but sometimes there are failures. In the generator mode, you have to replenish the fuel supply in the generator. 
Look for cans, and take them to the generator. Darkness comes .."
